rules.question: Does the client meet the assets-under-management threshold condition of the qualified-client rule? Answer only this specific condition, not other possible ways to qualify.
rules.facts_template: A natural person enters a new advisory contract. Immediately after entering, the person has ${amount:,} managed by that adviser. Consider only the assets-under-management condition; do not determine qualification under other alternatives.

evidence.excerpt: immediately after entering into the contract has at least $1,000,000 under the management of the investment adviser
immediately after entering into the contract has at least $1,100,000 under the management of the investment adviser

rules.metadata: Author-prepared version metadata: E1 applies to a new contract on 2021-08-15; E2 applies to a new contract on 2021-08-16. The task considers only these two dates and only the assets-under-management condition.

rules.question: Does the investment-income limitation alone disallow the earned income tax credit? Answer only this condition, not whether the taxpayer otherwise qualifies for the credit.
rules.facts_template: A taxpayer has ${amount:,} of aggregate investment income counted for the stated limitation in the hypothetical taxable year. Consider only whether this income disallows the credit under that limitation; do not determine whether other credit conditions are met.

evidence.excerpt: the earned income tax credit is not allowed under § 32(i) if the aggregate amount of certain investment income exceeds $11,600
the earned income tax credit is not allowed under § 32(i) if the aggregate amount of certain investment income exceeds $11,950

rules.metadata: Author-prepared version metadata: E1 applies to taxable years beginning in 2024; E2 applies to taxable years beginning in 2025. The task considers only a taxable year beginning on 2024-01-01 or 2025-01-01 and only the investment-income limitation.
